defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. Novu-hosted workers, server/client SDKs, CLI, MCP servers, agent toolkits, web chat, S3 storage, inbound email parse and real push/SMS/email delivery remain out of scope and are not claimed.
